what_this_is: The programs that read a link to a video or a recording on a person's Mac (kind hear-fetcher), tried in order by computer/hear-a-link.mjs and computer/list-a-channel.mjs: the first whose `check` answers here (its program found in `search_path`, then PATH) is used. Each payload has `info` (prints the page's facts as JSON), `captions` (writes the captions the page offers, in `languages`, into {folder}), `sound` (writes the sound alone into {folder}) and `list` (prints, as JSON, every video a channel, a channel's tab or a playlist lists, each without being read, for computer/list-a-channel.mjs); every value in braces is filled when it runs ({url}, {folder}, {languages}, {node}), and `update_hint` is what is told when a page refuses an old copy. The rest of how a link is heard (languages, kept sound, time, words) stays in computer/hear-a-link.json. A new reader is a new row.
